svg.title: Pentago: game 4, move 7
svg.desc: Game 4 of @tannergolden against GitHub, @tannergolden plays White and GitHub Black, under the Ghost Rule. Ghosts on b5 and d4. After 7. d5-ur-cw: a white marble on d5, then the upper right quarter turns clockwise. It is GitHub's turn as Black, due by 22 Oct. The upper left quarter: White on b6, White on c6, Black on a5, a ghost on b5, Black on c5; the upper right quarter: White on e6, White on f6, Black on f5, a ghost on d4, White on f4; the lower left quarter: Black on c3; the lower right quarter: White on f2, Black on d1, White on e1, Black on f1.
